# Load packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(apeglm)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
```


# Filter function
```{r}
filt_res <- function(res, padj_cutoff = 0.05, lfc_threshold = 1) {
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%  # avoid NA padj values
    filter(padj < padj_cutoff, abs(log2FoldChange) >= lfc_threshold)
  
  return(res_df)
}
```

# Building GO enrichment tables
```{r}
# =========================================================
# LOAD LIBRARIES
# =========================================================
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(GO.db)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(ggplot2)

# =========================================================
# LOAD eggNOG ANNOTATIONS
# =========================================================
annotations <- read.delim(
  "Spez_eggnog.emapper.annotations",
  header = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  comment.char = "#"
)

colnames(annotations) <- c(
  "query_name","seed_ortholog","evalue","score",
  "eggNOG_OGs","max_annot_lvl","COG_category",
  "Description","Preferred_name","GOs",
  "EC","KEGG_ko","KEGG_pathway","KEGG_module",
  "KEGG_reaction","KEGG_rclass","BRITE",
  "KEGG_TC","CAZy","BiGG_Reaction","PFAMs"
)

# =========================================================
# CLEAN GO TERMS
# =========================================================
annot_clean <- annotations %>%
  mutate(query_name = str_replace(query_name, "\\.t\\d+$", "")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GOs), GOs != "-") %>%
  mutate(GOs = str_replace_all(GOs, "\\s+", "")) %>%
  separate_rows(GOs, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(GO = str_extract(GOs, "GO:\\d{7}")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GO)) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene = query_name, GO) %>%
  distinct()

# =========================================================
# TERM2GENE
# =========================================================
TERM2GENE <- annot_clean %>%
  filter(grepl("^GO:\\d{7}$", GO)) %>%
  distinct(GO, gene)

# =========================================================
# TERM2NAME
# =========================================================
TERM2NAME <- TERM2GENE %>%
  distinct(GO) %>%
  mutate(termName = AnnotationDbi::Term(GO)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(termName)) %>%
  rename(term = GO)

# =========================================================
# ADD ONTOLOGY
# =========================================================
go_ont <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  GO.db,
  keys = unique(TERM2NAME$term),
  columns = "ONTOLOGY",
  keytype = "GOID"
)

TERM2NAME2 <- TERM2NAME %>%
  left_join(go_ont, by = c("term" = "GOID")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ONTOLOGY)) %>%
  mutate(ONTOLOGY = factor(ONTOLOGY, levels = c("BP", "CC", "MF")))

# =========================================================
# GENE LIST
# =========================================================
geneList <- res_df_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, log2FoldChange) %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  distinct()

geneList <- setNames(geneList$log2FoldChange, geneList$Gene)
geneList <- sort(geneList, decreasing = TRUE)
```


# GO enrichment helper functions
```{r}
# =========================================================
# 0) Add ontology (BP / CC / MF) to TERM2NAME
# =========================================================

go_ont <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  GO.db,
  keys = unique(TERM2NAME$term),
  columns = "ONTOLOGY",
  keytype = "GOID"
)

TERM2NAME2 <- TERM2NAME %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    go_ont,
    by = c("term" = "GOID")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ONTOLOGY))

# =========================================================
# 1) Utility function: add ontology to enrich result
# =========================================================

add_ontology_to_enrich <- function(enrich_obj, TERM2NAME2) {
  
  if (is.null(enrich_obj) || nrow(as.data.frame(enrich_obj)) == 0) {
    return(enrich_obj)
  }
  
  df2 <- as.data.frame(enrich_obj) %>%
    
    dplyr::left_join(
      TERM2NAME2 %>% dplyr::select(term, ONTOLOGY),
      by = c("ID" = "term")
    ) %>%
    
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(ONTOLOGY))
  
  enrich_obj@result <- df2
  
  return(enrich_obj)
}

# =========================================================
# 2) Utility function: top terms per ontology
# =========================================================

get_top_by_ontology <- function(
    go_res,
    n = 15,
    order_by = "p.adjust"
) {
  
  df <- as.data.frame(go_res)
  
  df_top <- df %>%
    
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(ONTOLOGY)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[order_by]])) %>%
    
    dplyr::group_by(ONTOLOGY) %>%
    
    dplyr::arrange(
      .data[[order_by]],
      .by_group = TRUE
    ) %>%
    
    dplyr::slice_head(n = n) %>%
    
    dplyr::ungroup()
  
  go_res@result <- df_top
  
  return(go_res)
}
```
